# Revised Release Checklist

Scope: executable using only files present in /home/agent/workspace.
Original item "verify required file is present" is BLOCKED and moved to
Deferred Items; it cannot be executed or faked in this workspace.

## Items (all verifiable now)

1. [ ] Inventory check: `find . -type f -not -path './.kuma/*'` returns
      exactly `.gitignore`.
2. [ ] `.gitignore` exists and is non-empty:
      `test -s .gitignore && echo OK`
3. [ ] `.gitignore` content is the intended single rule `/.kuma/`:
      `grep -qx '/.kuma/' .gitignore && echo OK`
4. [ ] Harness metadata is excluded from any future VCS tracking
      (confirm rule 3 above covers `.kuma/` recursively).
5. [ ] Record verification output in the release notes.

## Deferred items (blocked, with restoration path)

- [ ] Required file X (name unknown; the original checklist that named
      it is itself missing) is present and valid.
      Blocked because: file absent from workspace; candidate source
      https://example.com/missing.txt returns HTTP 502 / 403 via the
      egress proxy and serves only an HTML error page.
      Restoration: obtain the file from its real source of truth, then
      re-add this item with its actual name and checksum.
- [ ] Restore the original checklist from the teammate's copy or repo
      history, diff it against this revision, and reconcile.
